title: The 40 minutes when the Artemis crew loses contact with the Earth
byline: No-one will have been further from home than the Artemis astronauts.

title: Sun directly over parts of Sri Lanka today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Northern, Eastern, North-central, Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Puttalam, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m, today (06), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Iran warns to respond ‘‘in kind’’ to any US attacks on its infrastructure
byline: Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei responded to US President Donald Trump’s threats, warning that Iran will respond ‘‘in kind’’ to any attack on its infrastructure, Al Jazeera reported.

title: At least 11 killed in Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon on Easter Sunday
byline: An Israeli airstrike on Kfarhata, a village in south Lebanon, killed seven people on Sunday, including a 4-year-old child, Lebanon’s health ministry said in a statement.

title: Man attacked to death in Panamura; Two suspects arrested
byline: A 46-year-old man has been attacked to death in the Panamura area.

title: 12-hour water cut in Homagama area today
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 12-hour water cut for Homagama and surrounding areas (Zone 01) today (06).

title: Duo arrested for hoarding over 800L of diesel in Maradana
byline: Two suspects have been arrested in the Maradana area along D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha for hoarding 826 litres of diesel without a valid license.

title: Oil prices hit $110 after Trump’s latest threats
byline: Oil prices hit $110 (£83.38) a barrel after President Donald Trump’s expletive-laden threat against Iran on social media.

title: GMOA temporarily ends strike
byline: The island-wide strike launched by the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) will be temporarily concluded from 8.00 a.m. today (06).

title: One killed in truck-container collision on Southern Expressway
byline: An accident occurred this morning (06) near the Welipenna service area on the Southern Expressway when a truck crashed into the rear end of a container truck traveling ahead.

title: UAE joins Bahrain in urging UNSC action on St of Hormuz
byline: The UAE on Monday expressed its support to Bahrain in urging the Security Council to take action on the Strait of Hormuz.

title: National QR Payment Promotion Programme launched by President
byline: Marking a new milestone in Sri Lanka’s digital economy, the launch of the “National QR Payment Promotion Programme” officially commenced today (06) under the patronage of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Airstrike on Iranian city of Eslamshar kills at least 13
byline: An airstrike early Monday struck a residential building in a city southwest of Iran’s capital, Tehran, killing at least 13 people, Iranian media reported.

title: Chinese national arrested over murder of foreign woman in Kohuwala
byline: A 26-year-old Chinese national has been arrested in connection with the murder of a foreign national woman, who was attacked to death using a sharp weapon in a residence in the Kohuwala area.

title: Netflix to live stream Artemis II lunar flyby
byline: NASA’s Artemis II mission is officially underway, and while Netflix didn’t carry the live feed of the historic Earth departure on April 1st, space enthusiasts are in for a massive consolation prize.

title: Fire breaks out at wax fabric manufacturing factory in Wattala
byline: A fire has broken out this morning (06) at a wax fabric manufacturing factory located in the Mabola area of Wattala.

title: 12-hour water cut in Pelanwatta and surrounding areas
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that water supply to Pelanwatta and surrounding areas will be suspended from 8:00 p.m. today (6) until 8:00 a.m. tomorrow (7) as part of ongoing water management measures prompted by the prevailing dry weather.

title: Sri Lanka to receive normal rainfall by May or June – Met. Dept
byline: The Director General of the Department of Meteorology of Sri Lanka, Athula Karunanayake, stated that Sri Lanka is expected to receive its usual rainfall by May or June.

title: Iranian media says 15 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz in 24 hours
byline: Iran’s Fars news agency, which is affiliated to the country’s Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC), said earlier that 15 ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz ‘‘with permission from Iran’’ in the previous 24-hour period.

title: Iran Revolutionary Guard intelligence head killed
byline: The head of intelligence for Iran’s paramilitary Revolutionary Guard was killed Monday in an attack targeting him, Iranian state media said.

title: Sri Lankan passenger arrested with over 11 kg of ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: A Sri Lankan passenger has been arrested today (06) by officials of the Sri Lanka Customs Narcotics Control Division at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for smuggling a large consignment of Kush cannabis estimated to be worth around Rs. 113.4 million.

title: Strike hits Iranian university, gas outage in Tehran
byline: The Sharif University of Technology has been hit by a strike, causing a gas outage in parts of Tehran.

title: Iran, US receive plan to end hostilities, immediate ceasefire; source says
byline: Iran and the United States have received a plan to end hostilities that could come into effect on Monday and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a source aware of the proposals said on Monday.

title: Prices of several food items to increase from midnight today
byline: The All Ceylon Restaurant Owners’ Association has announced that the prices of ‘Rice and Curry’ packets, ‘Fried Rice’, and ‘Kottu’ will increase by Rs. 20 in response to the recent rise in domestic LP gas prices.

title: “Turning New Year transactions into QR payments will be a turning point” - President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stated that officials must provide the necessary impetus for society to embrace efficient practices.

title: A milestone for Artemis II: Astronauts enter the ‘lunar sphere of influence’
byline: The crew’s Orion capsule entered what’s known as the lunar sphere of influence at around 12:41 a.m. ET Monday, crossing into the region of space where the moon’s gravitational pull is stronger than the pull of Earth’s.

title: Iran has formulated its response to ceasefire proposals, foreign ministry spokesperson says
byline: Iran has formulated its positions and demands in response to recent ceasefire proposals conveyed via intermediaries, a foreign ministry spokesperson said on Monday, adding that negotiations were “incompatible with ultimatums and threats to commit war crimes.”

title: Two dead, two missing after Iran missile strike in Haifa, Israel
byline: Two people have been killed while search operations are underway for two more individuals after an Iranian ballistic missile struck a residential building in Haifa, Times of Israel reported on Monday.

title: Adjournment debate on Easter Sunday Attacks this week in Parliament
byline: An adjournment debate on the 2019 Easter Sunday Attacks is scheduled to be held in Parliament this week.

title: Sri Lanka-born actress allegedly dies by suicide in Chennai
byline: Tamil television actress Subashini, known for playing a key role in popular Tamil soap Kayal, has died by suicide in Chennai.

title: GMOA raises concerns over removal of specialist posts in hospitals
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has alleged that specialist medical posts have been removed from several hospitals across the country.

title: Special consumer protection program launched ahead of festive season
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has launched a special program to safeguard consumers in view of the upcoming festive season, Chairman Hemantha Samarakoon announced.

title: South Korea says ‘credible intelligence’ indicates North Korean leader’s daughter is successor
byline: South Korea’s spy agency now believes North Korean leader Kim Jong Un’s teenage daughter has been positioned as his successor, lawmakers said on Monday, citing a recent public display of her driving a tank that was likely intended to dispel any doubts.

title: National Child Protection Authority receives over 10,000 complaints in 2025
byline: The National Child Protection Authority (NCPA) reports that more than 10,000 complaints were recorded in 2025.

title: Former SIS Chief Suresh Sallay files writ petition challenging arrest and detention
byline: Former Head of the State Intelligence Service, Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay, has filed a writ petition before the Court of Appeal, through his attorneys, challenging his arrest and detention by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) under the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA).

title: Tender called for coal supply to Lakvijaya Power Plant
byline: A tender has been called to select a coal supplier for the 2026/2027 season of the Norochcholai Lakvijaya Power Plant.

title: Nigerian army rescues 31 held after Easter church attack
byline: Thirty-one civilians held hostage following a Sunday morning church attack in north-west Nigeria have been rescued, the army has said.

title: Providing ATM services puts significant financial burden on banks – Central Bank Governor
byline: The banking system bears a significant cost in providing cash transaction services through ATM machines, the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe has stated.

title: Energy conservation program introduced in schools
byline: The Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education has introduced the “Surakimu Lanka” school energy conservation programme aimed at building a culture of energy conservation within schools.

title: 12-hour water cut announced for several areas in Homagama tomorrow
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 12-hour water cut for Homagama and surrounding areas (Zone 02) tomorrow (07).

title: Israel hits Iran’s largest petrochemical complex after Trump threat
byline: Israel struck Iran’s largest petrochemical complex on Monday (Apr 6), as the Islamic Republic defied threats from US President Donald Trump to devastate civilian infrastructure if it does not reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Artemis crew reaches the moon, approaches record-breaking distance from Earth
byline: The four astronauts of NASA’s Artemis II mission entered the moon’s gravitational sphere of influence early Monday morning as they cruised along a path that will soon take them over the shadowed, lunar far side to become the farthest-flying humans in history.

title: Top EU official says any targeting of energy sites would be “illegal” after Trump threat
byline: European Council President António Costa warned Monday that the targeting of energy facilities would be “illegal and unacceptable” after US President Donald Trump threatened to hit Iranian power plants if the Strait of Hormuz is not reopened.

title: Minister Sunil Handunneththi holds discussions with IMF representatives
byline: A special meeting was held today (06) between Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development, Sunil Handunneththi, and representatives of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

title: OPEC+ agrees to boost oil output when Strait of Hormuz reopens
byline: OPEC+ agreed on Sunday to raise its oil output quotas by 206,000 barrels per day for May, a modest rise that will largely exist on paper as its key members are unable to raise production due to the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.

title: Indian Vice President CP Radhakrishna visit to Sri Lanka
byline: The Vice President of India, CP Radhakrishnan is scheduled to arrive on a two-day office visit to Sri Lanka.

title: Laugfs gas shipment arrives at Hambantota
byline: A vessel carrying 7,000 metric tonnes of LP gas arrived in the country, according to LAUGFS Gas PLC.

title: Imported cigarettes worth Rs. 507 million seized by Customs
byline: Sri Lanka Customs officials have seized 3,380,000 illegally imported foreign cigarette sticks during an inspection of a container brought into the country.

title: Special weekly Wednesday holiday granted to state sector cancelled from Apr. 8
byline: The special weekly Wednesday holiday granted to government offices, schools, universities and judicial services will be cancelled from April 8, the Commissioner General of Essential Services, Prabath Chandrakeerthi has announced.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Northern, North-Western, North-Central and Eastern provinces and the Monaragala and Hambantota districts.

title: Over 4,600 litres of hoarded diesel seized in Kalmunai
byline: A stock of 4,620 litres of diesel has been seized by Kalmunai Headquarters Police during a raid conducted today (06) on Madhavan Road in Kalmunai.

title: Sinopec increases price of Super Diesel
byline: Sinopec Energy Lanka (Private) Limited announced that it has increased the retail price of Super Diesel by Rs. 28 to Rs. 600 per litre with effect from midnight today (6).
